title: Direct-agent proof: endpoint request path
description: Route one OpenAI-compatible request to the supervised vLLM container and return a response, using the smallest viable gateway/runtime frontend path rather than broad provider-gateway scope.

logs.msg: Research validated: vLLM exposes /health (liveness), /v1/models (readiness), /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible). vllm/vllm-openai official Docker image. Endpoint is accessible on port 8000 by default.
